title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1986-03-23
source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif > Samplitude (.wav 16-bit/44.1k)> hard disk > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent audio transfer of the 03/23/86 Philadelphia Spectrum show, praised as a top‑quality audience source
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the sound quality, noting that the mastering and transfer bring the 1986 Philly Spectrum performance to life. The recording is described as “great” and the best available audience source, with no complaints noted about the music itself.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive (5 and 4 stars) and focus on superb audio quality; lack of musical commentary limits confidence, but the recording is clearly well‑received.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mastering/transfer praised as bringing the show to life; listeners describe the sound as great and the best audio source available.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on performance or set structure were provided.
